items.title: Homepage Lighthouse perf fix: TBT/parser-block root cause
items.insight: The Lighthouse CI failure (0.76 vs ≥0.80 threshold) traces to two root causes: supabase-public.js loading without defer (sole parser-blocking external script) and 25+ deferred scripts executing in a burst post-DOMContentLoaded. Adding defer to supabase removes the blocking load; moving ignis-tour, vault-pulse, vault-resonance, and recent-ships (~30KB total) to requestIdleCallback in home-idle-loader.js spreads their init across genuine idle gaps. pwa-install.js stays as static defer — the beforeinstallprompt event fires early during navigation and would be missed by an idle callback arriving 1800ms later.
items.evidence: index.html supabase-public.js has defer; home-idle-loader.js scripts array +4 entries; check-js-budget ✓; check-page-script-relevance ✓; lint-tt-policies ✓; Lighthouse CI green expected on next push

items.title: CANON-041 tap-target audit on S211-S213 features
items.insight: Five interactive buttons across S211-S213 new features measured below the 44px CANON-041 minimum. All five fixed: IGNIS vote buttons (36→44px), IGNIS tray tabs (added min-height:44px + flex), push-subscribe button (~31→44px), quiz CTA button, quiz retry button. The quiz option rows were already compliant at ~45px via line-height — audit rejected that finding honestly.
